title: Describe a Team
instructions:
Write a `Team` class with two properties: `number` (Int) and `name` (String).

Then write a function called `describe` that takes a `Team` parameter and returns a `String` in the format:
`"Team {number}: {name}"`

For example, `describe(Team(4215, "Tribots"))` should return `"Team 4215: Tribots"`.
hint: Define the class as `class Team(val number: Int, val name: String)`. In the `describe` function, use string templates: `"Team ${team.number}: ${team.name}"`.
